༄༅/ /ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa mdor bsdus pa 'jag tshugs ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa mdor bsdus pa 'jag tshugs ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

ma bsgom par sdig po che'ang 'tshang rgya bar byed pa 'pho ba'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid nyams su blang ba'i thabs la gnyis te/ sbyang thabs dang las la sbyar ba'o| |dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas lus rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can zhal gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan gsum mnga' ba mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra phyed bcings kyi sil bu rgyab tu grol ba/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa'i rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po ngur sgra 'byin pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pa g.yas kyi brla la sbyar ba/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyi sor mos baṃ ro ser po gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i snying khar mnan pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ dar dmar po dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa/ de'i khong pa'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma phyi sngo ba nang dmar ba mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ mda' smyug 'bring po tsam/ yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa'i snying kha tshigs kyis bcad pa lta bu'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo thig le dmar po sran ma'i rdog po tsam/ yang zhing g.yo ba 'phar la khad pa/ spyi gtsug tu dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs bug rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu yod pa'i steng du/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po sprul sku'i cha byad can chos gos gsum dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i khri la byams bzhugs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i mthe bong gis rang gi tshangs bug bkab pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor bar gsol ba btab cing*/

hika ྄gi sgras bskul ba la/ thig le de nyid spyi bor ma thon tsam du sangs rgyas kyi zhabs mtheb la tug tug song bar bsams shing*/ dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas/ mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do// o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// myur lam 'pho bas mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs| |bdag sogs 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// gter ston nyi zla sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs// mtshungs med nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// rtogs ldan saṃ gha bha dra la gsol ba 'debs// pha rgod dri med blo gros la gsol ba 'debs// chos rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// mtshungs med ma ti'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs// yongs 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// mtshungs med bi da'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas dkon mchog rin chen la gsol ba 'debs// rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa la gsol ba 'debs// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// myur lam 'pho bas mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// bdag sogs 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol ba btab cing hika ྄gi sgras bskul ba las/ spyi bo za zhing 'bur ba dang*/ shu thor 'byung ba dang*| dran med 'gro ba sogs byung na 'jag ma 'dzugs pa sogs lag len ltar bya zhing*/ thun mtshams su kā zhes pa'i sgras thig le rang sar mar phab la/ rjes bsngo bas rgyas gdab par bya'o// de dag ni sbyang ba'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ tshe 'das kyi ming nas bos te/ khyod shi ba yin no// tshe 'di'i snang ba ni nub/

phyi ma'i snang ba ni ma shar/ da lta bar do chos nyid yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig /de'ang khams drug ldan gyi mi lus gdos bcas kyi phung po lnga/ khams bzhi/ dbang po drug/ yul lnga/ ye shes lnga ste/ rags pa nyi shu rtsa lnga thim pas 'chi ba zhes bya ste/ de dag thim pa la rtags mang du yod kyang 'dir bsdus te rags pa 'byung ba bzhi'i thim tshul ni/ lus kyi sa'i khams chu la thim pas phyi rtags lus 'gul skyod mi nus shing zungs mi thub/ nang rtags shes pa du ba lta bu 'byung*/ chu me la thim pas phyi rtags lus kyi rngul dang kha chu la sogs pa bskam/ nang rtags shes pa smig rgyu lta bu 'byung*/ me rlung la thim pas phyi rtags lus kyi drod mtha' nas sdud cing*/ nang rtags shes pa srin bu me khyer lta bu 'byung*/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyi rtags dbugs phyir ring du rgyu zhing nang du sdud mi shes/ nang rtags mar me rlung gis skyod pa lta bu 'byung*/ de las phra ba'i snang ba gsum thim tshul ni/ rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim pas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la zla 'od shar ba lta bu'i snang ba dkar lam pa 'byung*/ zhe sdang las gyur ba'i kun rtog so gsum 'gag /snang ba mched pa la thim pas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la nyi 'od shar ba lta bu'i snang ba dmar lam pa 'byung*/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i kun rtog bzhi bcu 'gag /mched pa nyer thob la thim pas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la mtshams kyi smag gis khyab pa lta bu'i snang ba nag lam pa 'byung zhing*/ gti mug las gyur pa'i kun rtog bdun 'gag /der dran pa nyams nas nag tham gyis dran med du 'gro/ dran med de sangs nas nam mkha' slong byed kyi rkyen gsum dang bral ba'i tho rangs dus kyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu 'char te 'od gsal yin no// 'od gsal de la slar snang mched thob gsum skad cig re la 'char zhing*/ snang ba las kun rtog brgyad cu shar nas rnam shes rlung gi zhon pa can gyi bar do'i yid lus grub pa yin la/

de ltar ngos ma zin na dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis shig /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs gong ltar byas la/ dbu ma'i yar sne mtho gang gi tshad tsam du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhes bsgyur zhing*/ hika ྄ces pa'i mal du bdag gis phaṭa ces brda sbyar ba'i dus/ khyed rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo thig le de nyid dbu ma'i nang brgyud phyi mig mi blta bar rkyen pos mda' 'phang ba ltar sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar 'phos shig /ces sprad la/ gsol 'debs dang phaṭa kyis mtshams sbyar/ thebs pa'i rtags su rang nyid mgo bo na ba dang shes pa 'tshigs pa sogs 'byung*/ pha rol gyi spyi bo skrangs pa/ thod pa gol ba/ tsheg sgra 'don pa sogs 'byung ba thebs pa'i rtags yin la rtags ma byung gi bar du bskyar/ de ltar ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ mtsham med pa lnga byas pa'i sdig po can zhig yin yang*/ gdams pa 'di dang 'phrad na 'tshang rgya bar gdon mi za ba'i gdams ngag yin pas/ sngon chad yig cha dag ma dag sna tshogs zhig 'dug par brten dbon po thar pa gling pas dgos zer bar/ shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrtis zla dgon du sbyar ba'o// 'di la sngon du rang nyid sbyangs pa thengs pa gal che'o// rang gis ma sbyangs par gzhan la ston pa ni sāts+tsha'i sku par ri mo med pa dang 'dra/ 'pho ba 'debs pa'i dus ni gang zag mchog la khyad par med/ phal pa rnams la phyi dbugs chad pa'i drod mtha' nas bsdus te lus 'gul ba tsam du sleb dus 'debs/ mgo bo chag pa la 'pho ba 'debs rgyu med/ de min nad mtshon rbab gang gis shi'ang theb| chus khyer ba la'ang theb rgyu med/ mkha' 'gro las kun las btus pa'i rgyud las// lus can dag ni 'chi ba'i tshe// gal te thur la log gyur na// dge la spyod pa'i skyes bu yang*// ngan song du ni skye bar 'gyur// dper na lam du zhugs pa'i mi| |grogs kyis bsgyur ba bzhin du'o// zhes so/

/gdan bzhi las/ bu ga dgu yi steng phyogs na// 'phral du yid kyis bsgoms pas 'pho// nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang*// mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*// rku 'phrog 'dod log spyod pa yang*| |lam 'di yis ni dag par nus// zhes so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
